data.title: Storm (STORM) Token Swap to STMX Will Be Supported on Binance
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance will support the Storm (STORM) smart contract and token swap to StormX (STMX), with the following timeline:

  • Deposits and withdrawals of STORM will be suspended starting from 2020/06/07 4:00 AM (UTC), at which point we will begin the token swap.
  • Important: Please ensure that you leave sufficient time for your STORM deposits to be fully processed prior to this time. If deposited after this time, the tokens will not be credited to your account.
  • Trading will be halted in all STORM trading pairs at 2020/06/08 3:00 AM (UTC) and the trading pairs will also subsequently be delisted from the exchange. We will take an immediate snapshot of all STORM balances at the same time (2020/06/08 3:00 AM UTC), and begin the distribution of STMX to all eligible users at a ratio of 1 STORM = 1 STMX.
  • Trading will open for the new STMX/BNB, STMX/BTC, STMX/ETH and STMX/USDT trading pairs at 2020/06/11 3:00 AM (UTC). Deposits and withdrawals for STMX will also be opened at this time.

For further information, please refer to StormX Token Swap Technicality.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2020/06/03
